collect.//: Build the production site, then serve the static dist/ folder so Lighthouse audits the real, minified bundle (not the dev server).
collect.//url: Audit the homepage. lhci serves dist/ and visits this path.
collect.//numberOfRuns: Run 3 times and report the median to smooth out run-to-run noise.

assert.//: warn mode = scores are reported but never fail the build. Swap 'warn' for 'error' later to enforce thresholds.

upload.//: Push the full HTML reports to Lighthouse's free temporary storage and print a shareable URL in the job log.
